findings.evidence: In `Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/RealForm.lean`, line 88 references `ContinuousLinearMap.complexificationEquivOfIsMaximalTotallyReal` and line 222 uses `LinearMap.conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal`. The definition takes `(hT : TauCeti.IsMaximalTotallyRealMap IS I A f)` and builds the equivalence from `IsMaximalTotallyReal.normalEquiv`.
findings.fix: Rename the four declarations to `normalEquivOfIsMaximalTotallyReal`, `normalEquivOfIsMaximalTotallyReal_apply`, `toLinearEquiv_normalEquivOfIsMaximalTotallyReal` and `continuous_normalEquivOfIsMaximalTotallyReal`. Update the module title, docstrings and cross-references to say 'maximal totally real'.
findings.issue: `Manifold.IsImmersion.normalEquivOfTotallyReal` takes `hT : IsMaximalTotallyRealMap`, and maximality is what makes the map an equivalence. Without it the map is only injective, so the name overstates what a totally real hypothesis gives. The same issue affects `normalEquivOfTotallyReal_apply` (line 75), `toLinearEquiv_normalEquivOfTotallyReal` (line 85), `TauCeti.SmoothEmbedding.continuous_normalEquivOfTotallyReal` (line 108), the module title 'normal space of a totally real immersion', and the cross-references in `Lagrangian/Embedding/Normal/Euler.lean` docstrings (lines 31-32, 120).

summary: `normalEquivOfTotallyReal` and the lemmas built on it leave out 'maximal', which suggests a mere totally real immersion is enough for the tangent-to-normal equivalence and breaks with the `...OfIsMaximalTotallyReal` / `...OfMaximalTotallyReal` names already in the repo. The other new names describe their conclusions and are consistent with nearby declarations.
